Priya Kaur: Quick thread for Thu candidate (Ava Morgan) — final pre-onboard checklist. Arrival 9:30am, panel starts 10:00. Can we confirm parking, badge, desk, loaner, and dietary notes? @taylor @evelyn @sam
Sam Patel: I got parking — reserving 1 visitor spot in lot 3A. Need license plate; putting in request now.
Priya Kaur: Plate is 8XQ-442 (candidate). Sending to you in DM too. Thanks.
Evelyn Park: I'll handle badge & building access. Will request a temporary badge for 9:15am. Anyone want a printed schedule for the panel?
Taylor Ng: I can print schedules and stick name tent on the interview table. Also can reserve the conference room (Riverview B).
Jordan Lee: IT: setting up a loaner M1 (workstation) + network guest creds. ETA: drop on IT bench by 9:00. Any special software needed?
Priya Kaur: No heavy IDEs — just Zoom and Chrome, but please ensure the laptop has the camera enabled and guest Wi-Fi certificate preinstalled.
Sam Patel: Parking permit created and emailed to Priya. Parking spot #A12 reserved.
Evelyn Park: Badge request submitted: form link https://intranet.redwood/badge-request — used "Temporary Visitor" type. Onboarding Bot: Temporary badge created for Ava Morgan, expires 2026-03-29 18:00. Badge ID: VIS-78431.
Priya Kaur: Amazing, thank you. Two quick extras: 1) Candidate dietary — vegetarian + gluten-free. 2) Reimbursement envelope for travel receipts, please.
Taylor Ng: Got dietary. I'll order a boxed lunch labelled with restrictions and leave it at the panel table. Reimbursement envelope printed and included.
Jordan Lee: Loaner laptop is configured, labeled "LOAN-AvaM", ethernet & charger included. I left the guest Wi-Fi creds in a sticky note on the laptop: SSID: Redwood-Guest PW: Redwood@2026.
Evelyn Park: Security will meet candidate at the lobby at 9:20 and escort to Riverview B. I put the security contact in the calendar invite.
Priya Kaur: I'll send a final confirmation email to the candidate with arrival details + a map of parking and lobby check-in. Also adding a remote fallback Zoom link to the invite in case of delays.
Sam Patel: Small ask — can someone take a quick headshot for internal candidate tracking once they arrive? I can do it if nobody else is free.
Taylor Ng: I can take it. Quick and discrete.
Priya Kaur: Perfect. Thanks everyone — that should cover it. If anything changes ping here. :raised_hands:
